scope: REFERENCE ANALYSIS ONLY. No new painted character or hand/melon asset. No image generation. No repo/docs/assets/implementation writes.

landmark_conventions.actual_source_manual: Carried from actual-source S02a reference measurements and visually checked here; about +/-3–6 px. Eye_L/R are aperture tracking points, not pupil centers.
landmark_conventions.extra_manual: Focus eye apertures, pupils, and neck edges visually estimated here; about +/-4–6 px.
landmark_conventions.lower_chest: A/B/H are prior independently computed white-dot centroids, approx +/-1 px; source qa/measurements.json. Nearly collinear, diagnostic only.
landmark_conventions.bone_lengths: No measured 3D bone lengths available. Chin–collar and shoulder distances below are screen-space chords; shoulder points are sleeve/outer-contour observations, not shoulder joints.
landmark_conventions.new_pose_values: All new pose offsets, yaw and aperture dimensions are proposals, not measured new drawings or approved performances.

constraints: Low frontal head/shoulders close-up; Xiaoman hands, phone and elbow contact remain out of frame. No chin-in-hand.
Keep original 1672x941 guide coordinates; K19 scene crop is an integration decision.
Never register using moving shoulders. Do not apply the old 4.76%/3.28% scale fits; H residual remains about 5 px.
New art: neutral local color, 2–3 form-value layers. Scene lighting applied once. Old pale-blue chin/collar shading is recorded, never silently altered.
All references are sources, not approval of old alpha artifacts, face drift or weak tense expression.

counts.reuse_policy: d01/d02 have the same face intention; retain both exposure entries. No collapse or new art count reduction without reference gate.

projection_assumptions.head: Fixed cranial volume, no rescaling. Differential screen landmark shifts visualize weak-perspective yaw, but are not a rig or measured skull.
projection_assumptions.neck: Chin x shifts <=8px while collar stays at observed focus; local skin and collar occlusion need real drawing review.
projection_assumptions.gaze: Offscreen phone target is scene-stable, not attached to turning head. Do not aim pupils at the approaching melon.
projection_assumptions.camera: Same low frontal setup, slightly looser framing only at scene integration; do not scale the native character to match code body proportions.

contact_reference.selection_reason: k07 is the held S03 exit immediately preceding S03a. Both show the same intact melon, palm-up cradle and four curled fingers. Prefer the latest exact held source rather than a bitten S03b derivative.
contact_reference.chirality_evidence: Grandma turnaround shows jade bracelet on anatomical left wrist; S03 k07 screen-right resting hand carries it. The offered screen-left hand is therefore anatomical right, matching requested asset. Do not add bracelet to this right hand or mirror it.
contact_reference.measurement_method: Manual point picks on actual k07 at native 1670×941, checked in 3× crop (175,620)–(575,800); roughly +/-4–6 px. Finger naming order is only a silhouette trace, not joint reconstruction. Palm contact partly occluded by rind; patch is visual evidence, not measured load area.
contact_reference.observed_contact: Four fingers visibly wrap lower rind; palm continues beneath slice; thumb is visible on the far/side edge. No bite notch; red flesh contour remains intact. Wrist is downstream of palm, not the attachment point for a floating slice.
contact_reference.support_analysis: In the 2D crop, melon center proxy (~273,700) projects down into the finger/palm x-span (~220–325). This is a screen-space sanity check only; no 3D center of mass, physical load, or bone lengths are established.
contact_reference.view_compatibility: NOT approved as a finished S03a angle. S03 k07 is a side-on offer viewed toward grandma; S03a is a receiving-side close-up with the forearm entering from the camera-side bottom-right, requiring depth/foreshortening changes. A rigid 2D crop/rotation can test composition but cannot certify that view change.
contact_reference.new_angle_reference_brief: Use k07 for exact right-hand identity, unbitten melon silhouette and finger/palm contact. Obtain an explicit right-hand, palm-up, wrist-nearer-camera reference with forearm receding from lower-right toward the slice. Preserve correct thumb side; do not mirror k07, invent a reversed left hand, or hide contact with blur.
